difficulty_reason: A fixed-prime Bertini limit does not provide a bound uniform when the prime is larger than the section degree. The finite-field derivative-decoupling estimates and arithmetic tangent-space exact sequence remain substantive obligations before the final inverse-prime-square sum closes.
